title: A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM
abstract: arXiv:2609.07821v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) but incurs substantial computation and context costs. Existing methods either lose intermediate information through hard pruning or lack a principled criterion for continuous compression. We present A*-Thought-V2, a geometric dynamics of LLM guided framework that models CoT as a hidden-state trajectory and replaces hard deletion with an explicit-implicit interleaved latent architecture. After projecting question, step, and solution representations into a 3D PCA space, it measures alignment between each local transition and global question-to-solution direction. Aligned steps remain explicit text, whereas deviating steps are compressed into continuous latent tokens. translated_title: A*-Thought-V2：基于大语言模型几何动力学的高效潜在推理
translated_abstract: 思维链提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但会带来大量的计算和上下文开销。现有方法要么通过硬剪枝丢失中间信息，要么缺乏一个有原则依据的连续压缩准则。我们提出了A*-Thought-V2，一个由LLM几何动力学引导的框架，它将思维链建模为隐藏状态轨迹，并用显式-隐式交错的潜在架构取代硬性删除。在将问题、步骤和解答的表示投影到三维PCA空间后，该框架测量每个局部状态转移与全局“问题到解答”方向之间的对齐程度。对齐的步骤保留为显式文本，而偏离的步骤则被压缩为连续的潜在token。方向角度同时捕捉局部语义和推理动态：小角度表示直接执行和答案形成，而大角度更频繁地涉及检查、纠正（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: A*-Thought-V2将思维链建模为隐藏状态轨迹，在大语言模型的三维PCA几何空间中测量各推理步骤与全局解答方向的对齐角度，把偏离方向的步骤压缩为连续潜在token、对齐步骤保留为显式文本，从而在保留关键中间信息的同时大幅降低思维链推理的计算与上下文开销。
en_tdlr: A*-Thought-V2 models chain-of-thought as a hidden-state trajectory and leverages directional angles in a 3D PCA geometric space of LLM to retain aligned steps as explicit text while compressing deviating steps into continuous latent tokens, achieving efficient reasoning with substantially reduced computation and context costs.
